quantra_CalibrateSwaptionModelResponse.description: Response from Hull-White swaption model calibration.

rmse.description: Root-mean-square error computed from calibration helper errors.

num_helpers.description: Number of calibration helpers used (typically rows * cols).

grid_rows.description: Number of expiry rows in the calibration grid.

grid_cols.description: Number of tenor columns in the calibration grid.

grid_points.description: Total number of grid points in the calibration grid.

a_flatness.description:
How well the surface pins "a" (present iff calibrate_a): the relative
rmse increase when "a" is doubled or halved at the calibrated sigma,
1 - rmse / max(rmse(2a), rmse(a/2)). 0 = the objective is flat in "a";
values near 1 = "a" is sharply identified. Absent for a sigma-only fit.

a_poorly_identified.description:
True when a_flatness < 0.01: the fitted "a" is not supported by the
surface and should not be read as a market value. Present iff calibrate_a.
